Been working on my Zettelkasten Mac app... After some user feedback, I decided to go with a more traditional tree outline for displaying the note hierarchy and it works so much better than what I had before.

It combines elements of an outliner with networked notes apps like Obsidian and other PKMs.

More info: https://zettelkasten.ussherpress.com/ #mac #productivity
